note: Every home and furniture price in one place, for the owner to tune. A price in this file is on the prototype's scale; the game charges price x scale, rounded to round_to and never under minimum. To make everything dearer or cheaper change only `scale`. Why 0.05: stage rewards and jobs pay 50 to 1,200 rupees (about 58,000 in the whole content), the prototype's 60,000+ homes would be unreachable; at 0.05 a flat costs 3,000 (a few stages or about ten jobs), the old house 9,000, a new room 1,000 and a sofa 225. See docs/homes.md.
